notes: Three «ح» branches; the first two end with «جميعا عن شعبة», the third writes Shu'ba again («حدثنا شعبة»), and Amr, Murra and Abu Musa are written once after him. The tail is taken from that third occurrence (occurrence 2 of شعبة) so that it is contiguous in the text.
«- واللفظ له -» is a compiler's gloss and is left out; «أبي» is Mu'adh, named only by relation.
